question: What changed in Setup recently, and who changed it?

steps.name: changes
steps.soql: SELECT CreatedDate, CreatedBy.Name, Action, Section, Display, DelegateUser FROM SetupAuditTrail WHERE CreatedDate = LAST_N_DAYS:{days} [[AND Section = '{section}']] [[AND CreatedBy.Username = '{user}']] ORDER BY CreatedDate DESC LIMIT {limit}

verdicts.say: No Setup changes matched in the last {days} day(s).

traps: Deployments show up here under the deploying user, so a deploy and a hand edit can look alike; check ops.deploys at the same time.
